direction: Implement two candidates editing only algorithm.py and manifest.json: the sol_0002/sol_0003 boundary-gated ast_crossover and the sol_0002 fit-only out-of-fold residual subsystem rewrite, each paired against unchanged sol_0002 on instance:public-put-high-vol.

decision.analysis: sol_0002 remains the strongest scored parent (-0.000861). The cross-fitted monotone restart sol_0003 was worse overall (-0.001101), but its matched high-vol effect was positive yet inconclusive (0.000342; 95% CI [-0.002073, 0.002757]), suggesting potentially complementary boundary behavior rather than a win. The policy-iteration mutation sol_0005 timed out before evaluation, so it is an execution failure, not evidence against revised targets; sol_0006 only confirms the unchanged control. Next, compose complementary parent predictions and separately rewrite only sol_0002 fitting with a bounded out-of-fold correction, preserving matched budgets and targeting instance:public-put-high-vol.
decision.reason: Completed evidence supports testing complementary composition and a bounded fit-only revision while retaining sol_0002 as the unchanged control.
decision.success_criterion: At least one guided candidate has guided-minus-unchanged-sol_0002 mean discounted payoff greater than 0 on instance:public-put-high-vol.

mechanism_candidates.mechanism: Combine the live continuation graphs of sol_0002 and sol_0003: retain both fitted predictors, estimate time-local disagreement scales from training paths, and during prediction use sol_0002 except near its exercise boundary, where a deterministic volatility-and-disagreement gate blends toward sol_0003. This adds an executed gating branch rather than unconditional averaging.
mechanism_candidates.prediction: The guided composition produces positive guided-minus-unchanged-sol_0002 mean discounted payoff on instance:public-put-high-vol while retaining sol_0002 behavior outside boundary-disagreement states.
mechanism_candidates.failure_condition: The upper endpoint of the 95% confidence interval for guided-minus-unchanged-sol_0002 mean discounted payoff is below zero on instance:public-put-high-vol, or either parent predictor is dead code.
mechanism_candidates.matched_control: Unchanged sol_0002 under the identical seed, paths, and evaluator budget.
mechanism_candidates.next_probe: Report paired payoff effects stratified by whether the gate selected sol_0002, blended, or selected sol_0003.

mechanism_candidates.mechanism: Preserve sol_0002 prediction code and continuation interface, but replace its fit subsystem with one bounded out-of-fold residual-policy correction: generate fold-separated base continuation predictions, recompute realized stopping-policy targets once, fit a strongly regularized correction, and serialize it in the exact form consumed by the unchanged predictor.
mechanism_candidates.prediction: The guided fit rewrite produces positive guided-minus-unchanged-sol_0002 mean discounted payoff on instance:public-put-high-vol through improved targets without changing inference structure.
mechanism_candidates.failure_condition: The upper endpoint of the 95% confidence interval for guided-minus-unchanged-sol_0002 mean discounted payoff is below zero on instance:public-put-high-vol, or the unchanged predictor cannot consume the rewritten model state.
mechanism_candidates.matched_control: Unchanged sol_0002 under the identical seed, paths, and evaluator budget.
mechanism_candidates.next_probe: First run a bounded lifecycle diagnostic confirming fit completion, model-state compatibility, finite predictions, and exactly one correction pass before paired evaluation.
